args.title: Editor window body renders on a light ground

mutations.rationale: No requirement in the markdown-editor target states what colours the document area renders in. The window shipped on the vendor editor's dark defaults; the requested behaviour is a white ground with black text.

conflict.conflicting_text: Requirement statement: 'shall mark unsaved changes with a leading `*` on its title'; AC-1: 'then the title carries a leading `*`'.
conflict.code_behaviour: windowDialogModel.ts:31 now returns `${title}*`, so the marker trails the title.
conflict.resolution_chosen: update the requirement text and AC-1 to a trailing marker (option 1 of the conflict gate)

mutations.rationale: The head of a tray row is where a long path is elided, so a marker placed there abuts the `...` and reads as part of it. The tail is also the end both surfaces align on.
mutations.blocking_question: FR-MDE-006 pins the marker as leading in both its statement and AC-1. Confirm the requirement text is what changes, rather than the code.

mutations.rationale: The five controls, their order and their labels are unchanged; what changed is that each draws a glyph rather than a letter, and 최대화 became a two-state control carrying `aria-pressed`. No acceptance criterion of FR-MDE-001 is contradicted.

args.note_intent: AC-9: the tray icon carries a badge with the number of minimized windows of the current workspace, and carries none when that number is zero.

mutations.rationale: A minimized window leaves no other trace on screen, so the tray previously said only that something was folded away.

args.note_intent: AC-10: a tray row carries the window's absolute path rather than its file name; when the path exceeds the row bound its head is elided so that the file name and its nearest directories survive.

mutations.rationale: Nearly every window in this product is open on a file called CLAUDE.md, so a list of file names is a list of identical rows.
The shared glyph vocabulary the title bar controls draw through.
Holds both the badge count and the row label rule.
Six cases: the badge's workspace scoping and its zero cases, and the row label's distinguishability, whole-path case, head elision and marker position.
Asserts the trailing marker on the title text function, and that the component draws that value.

blocking_questions.question: FR-MDE-006 states the marker is leading, in both the requirement text and AC-1. The code now places it trailing. Update the requirement, or revert the code?
